verdict.rationale: Anrok publishes detailed API docs (apidocs.anrok.com) with an OpenAPI spec, endpoint descriptions, and sample curl requests (e.g., anrok-docs-40), showing a real reference exists. However, there is no evidence of an interactive, runnable 'try it now' console or sandbox environment — probes for standard OpenAPI/llms.txt discovery endpoints returned 404s, and nothing in the pack describes live code execution within the docs. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser interactive API console/sandbox, confirmation of llms.txt/OpenAPI discoverability, and any AI-native tooling (e.g., copy-as-curl, live request builder) beyond static text examples.
